claim: Apple itself states that for more than 90% of the billings and sales facilitated by the App Store ecosystem in 2025, developers paid no commission to Apple, out of a total ecosystem figure of over $1.4 trillion.
stance_target: Basis of the widely-cited '90% commission-free' statistic
scope_conditions: Global App Store ecosystem, 2025, per Apple-commissioned Analysis Group study
quoted_support: For more than 90 percent of the billings and sales facilitated by the App Store ecosystem, developers did not pay any commission to Apple.

claim: The $1.4 trillion ecosystem total splits into $1.1 trillion physical goods/services, $149 billion digital goods/services, and $151 billion in-app advertising -- only the $149 billion digital-goods slice is commissionable.
stance_target: Quantification of the true contingent (commissionable) revenue base versus gross ecosystem billings
quoted_support: sales of physical goods and services accounted for $1.1 trillion... Developer billings and sales for digital goods and services totaled $149 billion... In-app advertising revenue... was $151 billion.
